description: Senior Game Designer — systems, combat, economy and AI. Selected work across AAA co-development and award-winning indie titles.

blocks.html: I'm a Senior Game Designer with 6+ years of experience bridging deep systems design with hands-on production. I specialize in mechanics, balancing loops, and driving complex features from concept to final engine polish. Combining a design vision with a structural roadmap mindset, I manage cross-discipline dependencies across engineering, art and animation to deliver high-quality gameplay within scope.
